text:
leo_am: FYI MistralCare pilot tomorrow 09:00 SGT — they encountered throttles last week. Request: temporary APAC egress allowlist + short burst capacity (~600 QPS) for the demo (4h). Must preserve x-mistral-session header. Can we get a runbook + owner?

tia_support: Can you add customer CIDRs and the exact UTC start/end? Also note any renewal flags — they're in trials and mention quota as renewal blocker.

leo_am: CIDRs: 203.0.113.128/32, 198.51.100.77/32. Window: 2026-04-02 01:00 -> 05:00 UTC (09:00 -> 13:00 SGT). Renewal note: customer flagged stability + cost as concerns; successful demo could move renewal forward.

marc_netops: I'll own the edge config. Plan: create ephemeral policy scoped to mistralcare-prod, header passthrough, set steady qps conservative (50) with burst 600, auto-expire at 05:00 UTC. Will tag with billing tag "pilot-mistralcare".

anika_eng: Make sure we add a short-lived Grafana panel and a 429-rate alert to /eng-sre. Also, canary to apac-edge-a first for 10m. If 429>0.5% abort and rollback.

marc_netops: Suggested CLI snippet (run from infra jump):

```
# create ephemeral apac policy for mistralcare demo
redwoodctl policies create \
  --name mistralcare-apac-pilot-2026-04-02 \
  --project mistralcare-prod \
  --region apac \
  --cidrs 203.0.113.128/32,198.51.100.77/32 \
  --header-forward x-mistral-session \
  --qps 50 --burst 600 \
  --expires 2026-04-02T05:00:00Z \
  --tags pilot,mistralcare,billing-pilot
```

marc_netops: I'll apply to apac-edge-a (canary) and monitor for 10m. If all good, roll to apac-edge-b/c.

deploy-bot: policy created (edge-policy-2234) in apac-edge-a (canary).

leo_am: smoke test running — will post results. Also, can someone capture token cost delta during pilot for finance?

anika_eng: I'll add a short dashboard showing QPS, 429 rate, P95 latency, tokens/sec. Tagging metric export with pilot id so finance can query.

leo_am: smoke: curl returned 200 and header echoed. No 429s in first 8m. Demo lead said audio/video integrated flow looks good latency-wise.

marc_netops: Rolling to apac-edge-b/c now. Auto-revoke still scheduled at 05:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: roll complete — policy edge-policy-2234 active across apac edges.

anika_eng: Added Grafana panel and alert -> #eng-sre. Also exported pilot metrics to billing-export.pilot-2234.

leo_am: After the demo we'll want a brief postmortem note for account health: attach pilot metrics + customer quote, and propose steady-state quota uplift (approx +40% QPS) for renewal. Can product provide expected unit-cost delta for uplift?

anika_eng: I can run an estimate once we know sustained QPS. Will post numbers by EOD. Also recommend including suggestion to use prefix caching to lower unit costs.

deploy-bot: policy edge-policy-2234 auto-revoked at 2026-04-02T05:00:02Z (expiry).

leo_am: Demo complete — customer reported stable responses and lower perceived latency. Logging pilot success in account sheet and setting renewal follow-up: ask for steady-state quota bump and include cost estimate + caching recommendation in next convo. Thanks team! :tada:
